sentences.text: Radheshyam S/o Sh. Shantilal Menariya, Aged About 46  Years, R/o Manpura, P.s. Badi Sadri, Dist. Chittorgarh.

2. Shanti Lal Rawat S/o Bheru Lal, Aged About 53 Years, R/o  Kali Mangariya Bari Sadari, Chittorgarh.
3. Udai Lal Menariya S/o Baldev, Aged About 45 Years, R/o  Manpura, Mahoora, Chittorgarh.
4. Mukesh Kumar Menariya S/o Devi Lal Menariya, Aged  About 29 Years, R/o Manpura Mahoora, Chittorgarh.
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Mangi Lal S/o Ramaji Megwal, R/o Bhopatpura, Badi  Sadri, Chittorgarh.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anand Purohit, Sr. Advocate  assisted by Mr. Mayank Roy For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.S. Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 21/04/2023 Heard.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1-State.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2.
Rule is made returnable in the month of July.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, petitioner No.1 - Radheshyam S/o Sh. Shantilal Menariya, shall not be arrested in FIR No.0249/2021, Police Station Badi Sadri, District Chittorgarh for offences under Sections 447, 420, 467, 468, 471 & (2 of 2) [CRLMP-1723/2023] 504 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(f), 3(1)(g), 3(1)(r), 3(2)(s) & 3(2) (va) of SC/ST Act.
However, he shall join the investigation.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 43-Rashi/-
